entities.summary: Florence Rita Arrey is a Cameroonian judge who was the first female chief justice of the Court of the Appeal. She has served on the Supreme Court of Cameroon, and is a vice president of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda. In 2014, she was appointed director of judicial professions in the Cameroonian Ministry of Justice.
